name: @bdd-suite/runtime
description: The TypeScript runtime of the BDD suite format: suiterun lint, run, list and actions, an in-process linter for editors, and an extension API for adding actions, context keys, options and rules.

scripts.test: npm run build && npm run build:test && c8 --reporter=text --reporter=text-summary --reporter=json-summary --include "dist-test/src/**" node --test "dist-test/test/**/*.test.js" && node scripts/check-branches.mjs
